summary: Most touched support and release surfaces now point at Neo Zed, but the Help menu still exposes an upstream-branded social entry. Because `crates/zed/src/zed/app_menus.rs` was updated in this feature yet still shows `Zed Twitter` and links to `https://twitter.com/zeddotdev`, the app continues to present an upstream public support surface from a Neo Zed build.

issues.description: The Help menu still contains the upstream-branded `Zed Twitter` entry pointing at `https://twitter.com/zeddotdev` in `crates/zed/src/zed/app_menus.rs`, so this feature leaves a touched release-facing support surface presenting Zed rather than Neo Zed.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace that menu item with an approved Neo Zed social/community destination, or remove the entry until a fork-owned replacement exists, then rerun networked-surfaces scrutiny.
